text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Show some appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She said those words one morning
before returning home, the lingering excitement of winning the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe still fresh...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"I have fulfilled my grand purpose.
A glorious feat that shall be praised on the lips
of every subject far and wide."
choice_data_list: Yeah! It'd be my pleasure to pamper you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since she pulled off such a magnificent victory,
I want her to relax and let loose to her heart's content.
I won't spare any budget or effort……!
choice_data_list: Is there anywhere you want to go?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Do as you see fit.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"I merely seek...
It is your job to give form to that vast unknown."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I won't accept "I can't" for an answer.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I brought this 'wand'.
...Show me what you can do."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
choice_data_list: Let's walk, this might be the last time we see this scenery.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Good.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking her race fatigue into account,
I put together a relaxing sightseeing plan.
On our way, we gaze out at the Seine...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
choice_data_list: You really did great out there. That was a magnificent victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was... through and through, a "king."
No matter the circumstances, she ran without a shred of doubt in her victory,
and—she proved it brilliantly.
choice_data_list: Magnificent — she was a true king—!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
That must have been so.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
All people bow before the King.
Even the people of this land.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: However, I cannot become a crutch.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: This is no scepter of hollow vanity. It is one worthy of supporting my sovereign form.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Because it doesn't break, I've grown accustomed to using it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A lump formed in my throat.
Borne from the pride of having supported her...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
What are you dawdling for?
Lead the way at once.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I walk in front so she won't see my face.
...Because if I let my guard down, I feel like I might get overwhelmed by emotion and collapse on the spot.
